name: adr
description: Architecture Decision Records for a repository: see what is already decided, and record a decision the moment it is made. Format and bar vendored from mattpocock/skills (MIT).

interface.shortDescription: Architecture Decision Records for a repository
interface.longDescription: Keep a repository's architecture decisions in docs/adr as one short Markdown file each. Read what is already decided before proposing a change, record a new decision only when it is hard to reverse, surprising without context, and the result of a real trade-off, and check the files for format violations.
defaultPrompt: What has already been decided in this repository?
